title: App entry and presentation
description: The activity hosts Compose; root state selects onboarding or the authenticated shell. Screen state and user actions are coordinated by the main view model.

title: Login and persistent renewal
description: Authentik's browser flow uses PKCE. Its gateway token and Lunara's own app session are separate credentials; both must renew without confusing temporary network faults with revoked access.

anchors.purpose: PKCE browser login, provider token refresh and scoped persistence
Serialized, cancellation-safe renewal through durable commit
Encrypted credentials, atomic provider state and account generation checks
Inner Lunara session rotation and failure classification
Origin-bound gateway and app authorization headers
Server rotation, same-family proof, expiry, replay recovery and revocation
Signed external identity verification and provider outage classification

title: Offline data, synchronization and logout
description: Room/SQLCipher retains scoped local data and queued edits. WorkManager coordinates retries; server changes and logout must not allow old requests to restore another session.

anchors.purpose: Encrypted local schema and migrations
Local journal writes and queued mutations
Bounded upload/download batches and retry policy
Immediate, manual and periodic background work
Explicit logout and local-account cleanup coordination

title: Recorded-period transfer
description: Date-only CSV and JSON transfer is tracker-owned. File parsing precedes an explicit preview and confirmation; duplicate records are skipped, conflicting ranges reject the batch, and an account change invalidates pending file operations. Android persists the import atomically with its sync queue; the web uses its encrypted local vault or the authenticated server import.

anchors.purpose: Bounded date-only formats, validation and import planning
SAF input/output and owner-bound snapshots
Browser CSV/JSON compatibility and validation
Authenticated server import and generation-bound retries
Server export and atomic previewed import

title: Shared calendar appearance
description: Android supplies the visual reference. Both clients use rose for recorded days, one dashed amber category for the whole estimated period and teal for estimated fertility, with three matching symbols and legend entries. Recorded entries take precedence. The browser displays only complete, valid prediction boundaries using the same projection as Android; this does not calculate new predictions or grant access to private data.

anchors.purpose: Explicit light/dark semantic colors independent of decorative branding
Recorded, forecast and fertility presentation priority
Native legend with solid and dashed category borders
Native-equivalent validation of existing prediction boundaries
Browser calendar controls, category styling and accessible statuses
Matching browser legend and meaningful non-color labels

title: Prediction model and current-summary freshness
description: API and offline engines use the same supported history and duration limits. Phase consumers use the existing prediction center and configured luteal assumption. Summary policies suppress past start windows and pending server edits without changing stored history or calendar bands; foreground midnight/resume updates are bounded. These checks prove software consistency, not clinical accuracy.

anchors.purpose: Canonical cycle and duration model with uncertainty and eligibility
Common model center for permitted phase consumers, not a confirmed ovulation
Native offline estimate
Browser offline estimate with matching duration selection and fallback bounds
Native summary cutoff, pending changes and timezone day boundary
Browser current-summary classification without modifying cached data

title: Partner calendar consent and availability
description: The server reports effective sharing permissions without disclosing whether private health records exist. Clients distinguish denied or unknown access, unavailable estimates and empty results. Forecasts remain estimates, not a contraception or ovulation confirmation.

anchors.purpose: Privacy-filtered response and effective calendar access flags
Native calendar notices and read-only sharing status
Consent-aware browser calendar projection
Validate estimate availability independently of other prediction permissions
Same-origin stable APK download in settings
